questions.stem: What is a limitation of the term-to-term rule compared to a position-to-term rule?

options.text: It only works for arithmetic sequences
You need to know all previous terms to find a specific term
It always gives the same answer as the position-to-term rule

questions.explanation: With a term-to-term rule, you must calculate every term from the start to reach a particular term. A position-to-term (nth term) rule lets you jump directly to any term.
